public_rationale: The sentence reports Marcus's own certainty that neurosymbolic AI 'can help'. It does not say how much, on what measure, for which systems, or by when. A bare claim that something can help has no plain reading that evidence could prove false. Any one narrow positive result would trivially meet it. Some 2025–2026 preprints report gains from combining LLMs with symbolic tools, but none can settle a claim this open, so I do not score it.
limitations: If the speaker had committed to a specific benchmark or degree of improvement, the claim could be tested.
